method: Exact hash-pinned original function slices in Node VM; DOM/CSS, measurements, parent-panel layout, event action bodies and animation queue are explicit dependency stubs. No original app/GUI/browser rendering.

sequence: logical requested-size cache if width or height truthy
contract.doubleZero: CSS0x0 but previous logical size cache survives
contract.fractional: Unrounded requested cache and raw relative position deltas
contract.negative: No clamp in inspected query layer; browser used behavior not probed
contract.rotation: Owner rotation unchanged; alignment deltas in containing-coordinate axes
contract.parentFit: Before alignment move; no default second fit callback
contract.reentrant: Synchronous resize processing may alter geometry before subsequent alignment move
contract.typeBoundary: Only resizable ordinary VectorShape path recommended; emitted native flags alone are insufficient

limits: CSS stub records assignments; does not model browser clamping, used boxes, 1/64 quantization or border-box minimums
Height/width measurements are injected, not font measurements
Synthetic event dispatcher is original; handler body is a synchronous snapshot/mutation stub, not full case/menu/Wait execution
Repeater fit dispatch is original; child bounds and row-size sink are stubbed, not original push layout
No general transform, fixed panel/layer wrapper DOM, image offsets, parent panel full resize or SVG rendering is probed
